_comment: Odd statements with the explanation shown after answering. The explanation is half the fun of the round, so it is never left out.

afirmaciones.texto: Octopuses have three hearts.
afirmaciones.explicacion: Two pump blood to the gills and the third to the rest of the body. The third stops when they swim, which is why they prefer walking.

afirmaciones.texto: Honey never spoils.
afirmaciones.explicacion: Its acidity and very low moisture stop bacteria growing. Edible honey has been found in Egyptian tombs.

afirmaciones.texto: The Great Wall of China is visible to the naked eye from the Moon.
afirmaciones.explicacion: It is enormously long but very narrow. No human structure is visible from the Moon.

afirmaciones.texto: Bananas are slightly radioactive.
afirmaciones.explicacion: They contain potassium, and some natural potassium is the isotope potassium-40. The dose is negligible.

afirmaciones.texto: Lightning never strikes the same place twice.
afirmaciones.explicacion: The Empire State Building is hit around twenty times a year.

afirmaciones.texto: Flamingos are born grey.
afirmaciones.explicacion: The pink comes from carotenoids in what they eat, mostly crustaceans and algae.

afirmaciones.texto: Hot water weighs more than cold water.
afirmaciones.explicacion: Water expands when heated, so a litre of hot water weighs slightly less.

afirmaciones.texto: Snails can sleep for three years straight.
afirmaciones.explicacion: In very dry conditions they enter estivation and can stay inactive for years.

afirmaciones.texto: Napoleon was unusually short for his time.
afirmaciones.explicacion: He was about 1.68 m, slightly above the French average of the day. The myth comes from British propaganda.

afirmaciones.texto: Dolphins sleep with half their brain at a time.
afirmaciones.explicacion: They alternate hemispheres so they can keep surfacing to breathe.

afirmaciones.texto: Sound travels faster in water than in air.
afirmaciones.explicacion: About 1,480 m/s versus 343 m/s, because water is far less compressible.

afirmaciones.texto: Camels store water in their humps.
afirmaciones.explicacion: The hump is fat. Water is held in their blood and tissues.

afirmaciones.texto: There are more stars in the observable universe than grains of sand on Earth.
afirmaciones.explicacion: Estimates give around 10^22 stars against roughly 10^19 grains of sand.

afirmaciones.texto: Tomatoes are technically a fruit.
afirmaciones.explicacion: Botanically they are a fruit: they grow from the flower and carry seeds.

afirmaciones.texto: Your heart stops when you sneeze.
afirmaciones.explicacion: The rhythm changes for a moment because of the pressure, but the heart does not stop.

afirmaciones.texto: Mars has the tallest volcano in the solar system.
afirmaciones.explicacion: Olympus Mons, about 22 km high, more than twice Everest.

afirmaciones.texto: Giraffes have more neck vertebrae than humans.
afirmaciones.explicacion: They have seven, the same as us. Much longer ones, mind you.

afirmaciones.texto: Glass is a liquid that flows very slowly.
afirmaciones.explicacion: It is an amorphous solid. Old panes are thicker at the bottom because of how they were made.

afirmaciones.texto: Koalas sleep up to twenty hours a day.
afirmaciones.explicacion: Eucalyptus gives very little energy and is hard to digest.

afirmaciones.texto: A year on Venus is shorter than a day on Venus.
afirmaciones.explicacion: It orbits the Sun in 225 Earth days and spins once in 243.

afirmaciones.texto: Humans share more than 90 % of their DNA with bananas.
afirmaciones.explicacion: Depending on how you measure, the real figure is around 40-60 % and only counts comparable genes.

afirmaciones.texto: Blood is never blue.
afirmaciones.explicacion: Venous blood is dark red. It looks blue because of how skin scatters light.

afirmaciones.texto: There are penguins at the North Pole.
afirmaciones.explicacion: Every wild species lives in the southern hemisphere.

afirmaciones.texto: A teaspoon of neutron star would weigh more than Everest.
afirmaciones.explicacion: Its density is around a billion tonnes per cubic centimetre.

afirmaciones.texto: Bats are blind.
afirmaciones.explicacion: Almost all of them can see; they use echolocation because it works better at night.

afirmaciones.texto: White chocolate contains no cocoa at all.
afirmaciones.explicacion: It contains cocoa butter, just not cocoa solids, which is what would give it colour.

afirmaciones.texto: You cannot cry in space the way you do on Earth.
afirmaciones.explicacion: Without gravity tears do not fall: they cling in a ball around the eye.

afirmaciones.texto: Ostriches bury their heads in the sand when frightened.
afirmaciones.explicacion: They lower their heads to eat or turn their eggs. When scared, they run.

afirmaciones.texto: Everest grows a few millimetres every year.
afirmaciones.explicacion: The Indian plate keeps pushing against the Eurasian one.

afirmaciones.texto: Steel is lighter than aluminium.
afirmaciones.explicacion: Steel is almost three times denser.

afirmaciones.texto: One country has a flag that is not rectangular.
afirmaciones.explicacion: Nepal's flag is two overlapping pennants.

afirmaciones.texto: Cats cannot taste sweetness.
afirmaciones.explicacion: They lack working sugar receptors; they are strict carnivores.

afirmaciones.texto: Greenland belongs to Denmark.
afirmaciones.explicacion: It has been an autonomous territory of the Kingdom of Denmark since 1979.

afirmaciones.texto: The largest desert in the world is the Sahara.
afirmaciones.explicacion: It is Antarctica: a desert is defined by rainfall, not temperature.

afirmaciones.texto: Bees can recognise human faces.
afirmaciones.explicacion: Experiments show they distinguish facial patterns and remember them.

afirmaciones.texto: Gold is edible.
afirmaciones.explicacion: Gold leaf is inert and is approved as a food additive.

afirmaciones.texto: There are ants in Antarctica.
afirmaciones.explicacion: It is the only continent with no native ants.

afirmaciones.texto: A garden snail has thousands of teeth.
afirmaciones.explicacion: Its radula carries thousands of tiny teeth it uses to rasp food.

afirmaciones.texto: The Leaning Tower of Pisa started leaning because of an earthquake.
afirmaciones.explicacion: It began leaning during construction, on soft, uneven ground.

afirmaciones.texto: Decaffeinated coffee contains no caffeine whatsoever.
afirmaciones.explicacion: A small amount remains: EU rules allow up to 0.1 %.

afirmaciones.texto: Saturn would float in water if you had a big enough bath.
afirmaciones.explicacion: Its average density is less than water's, around 0.69 g/cm³.

afirmaciones.texto: Newborns see in colour from day one.
afirmaciones.explicacion: Colour vision develops over the first few months.

afirmaciones.texto: The largest living organism on the planet is a fungus.
afirmaciones.explicacion: An Armillaria in Oregon covers several square kilometres.

afirmaciones.texto: Sharks existed before trees.
afirmaciones.explicacion: Sharks go back about 400 million years; the first trees about 385.

afirmaciones.texto: The Moon is moving away from Earth.
afirmaciones.explicacion: About 3.8 cm a year, measured using reflectors left by the Apollo missions.

afirmaciones.texto: Hair and nails keep growing after death.
afirmaciones.explicacion: The skin dehydrates and retracts, which makes it look as if they have grown.

afirmaciones.texto: There are more trees on Earth than stars in the Milky Way.
afirmaciones.explicacion: About three trillion trees against a hundred to four hundred billion stars.

afirmaciones.texto: Wi-Fi works using radio waves.
afirmaciones.explicacion: It uses microwaves, which are high-frequency radio waves.

afirmaciones.texto: Elephants are the only animals that cannot jump.
afirmaciones.explicacion: They cannot, but neither can sloths, hippos or rhinos.

afirmaciones.texto: The deepest point in the ocean is in the Pacific.
afirmaciones.explicacion: The Mariana Trench, at nearly 11,000 metres.

afirmaciones.texto: Emperor penguins incubate their egg on their feet.
afirmaciones.explicacion: The male does it, enduring months of Antarctic winter without eating.

afirmaciones.texto: The river carrying the most water in the world is the Nile.
afirmaciones.explicacion: It is the Amazon. The Nile is among the longest but carries far less water.

afirmaciones.texto: You can hear the northern lights crackle.
afirmaciones.explicacion: They happen tens of kilometres up, and sound does not travel through a vacuum.

afirmaciones.texto: Horses cannot vomit.
afirmaciones.explicacion: The anatomy of their oesophageal sphincter prevents it, which is why colic is so serious.

afirmaciones.texto: There are more than a thousand varieties of banana.
afirmaciones.explicacion: Over a thousand cultivated varieties are known, even if almost all trade uses one.

afirmaciones.texto: Iceland has no mosquitoes.
afirmaciones.explicacion: Its climate and thaw cycles do not let them complete their life cycle.

afirmaciones.texto: The first computer weighed less than a hundred kilos.
afirmaciones.explicacion: ENIAC weighed about 27 tonnes and filled a whole room.

afirmaciones.texto: Sunflowers follow the Sun all their lives.
afirmaciones.explicacion: Only while young; once they flower they settle facing east.

afirmaciones.texto: A litre of seawater contains more than thirty grams of salt.
afirmaciones.explicacion: Average salinity is around 35 grams per litre.

afirmaciones.texto: The tongue has separate zones for each taste.
afirmaciones.explicacion: The famous tongue map is a misunderstanding: receptors for all tastes are spread all over it.

afirmaciones.texto: Lightning is hotter than the surface of the Sun.
afirmaciones.explicacion: A lightning channel can exceed 27,000 °C; the solar surface is about 5,500 °C.

afirmaciones.texto: A sheet of paper folded 42 times would reach the Moon.
afirmaciones.explicacion: Each fold doubles the thickness: 2^42 times 0.1 mm is over 400,000 km. Actually folding it is another matter.

afirmaciones.texto: Sea otters hold hands while they sleep.
afirmaciones.explicacion: They form rafts, holding on to each other so the current does not separate them.

afirmaciones.texto: The metric system was born in France.
afirmaciones.explicacion: It was adopted during the French Revolution, at the end of the 18th century.

afirmaciones.texto: An avocado is a fruit with a stone, like a peach.
afirmaciones.explicacion: Botanically it is a single-seeded berry.

afirmaciones.texto: Zebras are white with black stripes.
afirmaciones.explicacion: Their skin is dark: the white comes from areas without pigment.

afirmaciones.texto: The human eye can distinguish millions of colours.
afirmaciones.explicacion: Common estimates are around a million, and some go considerably higher.

afirmaciones.texto: A jellyfish can be biologically immortal.
afirmaciones.explicacion: Turritopsis dohrnii can revert to its polyp stage and start over.

afirmaciones.texto: Adults have fewer bones than babies.
afirmaciones.explicacion: We are born with about 300 and many fuse until 206 remain.

afirmaciones.texto: The first commercial video game was Pong.
afirmaciones.explicacion: Computer Space came first, in 1971; Pong is from 1972 and was the one that took off.

afirmaciones.texto: The capital of Turkey is Istanbul.
afirmaciones.explicacion: It has been Ankara since 1923, even though Istanbul is far bigger.

afirmaciones.texto: There is a shark that lives more than three hundred years.
afirmaciones.explicacion: The Greenland shark is the longest-lived vertebrate known.

afirmaciones.texto: Coca-Cola was originally green.
afirmaciones.explicacion: It was always caramel coloured; the bottles were green.

afirmaciones.texto: There is a country with no rivers at all.
afirmaciones.explicacion: Several, in fact, including Saudi Arabia and Malta.

afirmaciones.texto: Antarctica has no time zone of its own.
afirmaciones.explicacion: Stations use the time zone of whichever country supplies them.

afirmaciones.texto: Bananas are berries, botanically speaking.
afirmaciones.explicacion: And strawberries are not: their «seeds» are the actual fruits.

afirmaciones.texto: A snail can sleep for three years straight.
afirmaciones.explicacion: In dry weather it enters estivation and can stay put for years.

afirmaciones.texto: There are more stars in the universe than grains of sand on Earth.
afirmaciones.explicacion: Estimates give around 10²² stars against 10¹⁹ grains.

afirmaciones.texto: A blue whale's heart can weigh as much as a small car.
afirmaciones.explicacion: Around 180 kg, roughly a large engine.

afirmaciones.texto: Napoleon was shorter than average for his time.
afirmaciones.explicacion: He was about 1.68 m, which was normal in France back then.

afirmaciones.texto: Tongue prints are unique, like fingerprints.
afirmaciones.explicacion: The pattern of papillae differs from person to person.

afirmaciones.texto: Octopuses have three hearts and nine brains.
afirmaciones.explicacion: A central brain plus a ganglion per arm, and two gill hearts.

afirmaciones.texto: The Eiffel Tower can be 15 cm taller in summer.
afirmaciones.explicacion: Iron expands with heat.

afirmaciones.texto: Eating carrots noticeably improves night vision.
afirmaciones.explicacion: They provide vitamin A, which you need, but no extra night vision.

afirmaciones.texto: Sharks are older than trees.
afirmaciones.explicacion: The first sharks date back around 400 million years.

afirmaciones.texto: Bees always die after stinging.
afirmaciones.explicacion: Honeybee workers do; other bees and wasps do not.

afirmaciones.texto: Lightning can strike the same place twice.
afirmaciones.explicacion: The Empire State Building is hit dozens of times a year.

afirmaciones.texto: Swallowed chewing gum takes five years to digest.
afirmaciones.explicacion: It is not digested at all: it passes through in a couple of days.

afirmaciones.texto: Honey does not spoil.
afirmaciones.explicacion: Edible honey thousands of years old has been found in Egyptian tombs.

afirmaciones.texto: You cannot cry in space.
afirmaciones.explicacion: You can, but the tears stay stuck to your eye in a blob.

afirmaciones.texto: Dolphins sleep with half their brain awake.
afirmaciones.explicacion: That way they keep surfacing to breathe and stay alert.

afirmaciones.texto: Scotland has a mythical animal as its national animal.
afirmaciones.explicacion: The unicorn, since the 15th century.

afirmaciones.texto: Stainless steel was invented by accident.
afirmaciones.explicacion: Harry Brearley was after a steel for gun barrels and noticed it did not rust.

afirmaciones.texto: Clouds weigh nothing.
afirmaciones.explicacion: A medium cloud weighs hundreds of tonnes; it floats because the air below is denser.

afirmaciones.texto: The country with the most pyramids is Egypt.
afirmaciones.explicacion: It is Sudan, with around 250 in the Meroe region.

afirmaciones.texto: A spoonful of neutron star would weigh billions of tonnes.
afirmaciones.explicacion: Its density is on the order of 10¹⁷ kg/m³.

afirmaciones.texto: The highest point on Earth measured from the centre is Everest.
afirmaciones.explicacion: It is Chimborazo in Ecuador: the Earth is flattened at the poles.

afirmaciones.texto: A pig cannot look up at the sky.
afirmaciones.explicacion: Its neck anatomy almost entirely prevents it.

afirmaciones.texto: Lightning heats the air hotter than the surface of the Sun.
afirmaciones.explicacion: Up to about 30,000 °C against the Sun's 5,500 °C surface.

afirmaciones.texto: Giraffes have more neck vertebrae than people.
afirmaciones.explicacion: They have seven, same as us, just far longer.

afirmaciones.texto: Humans share about half their genes with a banana.
afirmaciones.explicacion: Many basic cell genes are common to almost all life.

afirmaciones.texto: A group of crows is called a murder.
afirmaciones.explicacion: It is the standard collective noun in English.
